VeriPark is a global technology powerhouse with more than two decades of experience in the financial services industry. Our mission is to enable financial institutions to become digital leaders by delivering world class customer journeys.
With offices in 15 countries from Canada over Europe and the Middle East to Kuala Lumpur, our 1000+ colleagues are serving customers in more than 30 countries worldwide.
r: Are you a proven banking technology sales professional looking to make a significant impact on a growing FinTech company? VeriPark is seeking an energetic and driven Account Manager to accelerate our expansion into the North American market - Canada. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of VeriPark in the Canada by generating new sales and building lasting relationships with banks, credit unions and financial institutions.
Achieve assigned targets by selling VeriPark’s Banking CRM, Digital Channels, Branch automation, and Loan Origination solutions and SI services to financial institutions.
Identify and pursue cross-selling and upselling opportunities within existing accounts.
Manage and grow a portfolio of multiple financial institution clients valued at USD $5 million or more over the last 3 years.
Develop and maintain detailed account maps and strategic account plans, including key stakeholders, opportunities, risks, and growth priorities.
Partner with internal teams (marketing, product, etc.) to align sales strategies and product positioning to market needs.
Identify and engage with key decision-makers in target financial institutions.
Apply Challenger Sale principles and adhere to the VeriPark sales process, incorporating MEDDICC methodology to ensure structured qualification, pipeline discipline, and predictable outcomes.
Expertly communicate the value proposition of VeriPark’s solutions vis-à-vis market needs and competitors’ offerings.
Manage the sales process end-to-end, from early-stage lead generation efforts, through evaluation and selection phases to contract negotiation.
Collaborate with pre-sales / proposal teams to deliver sales presentations, demonstrations and proposals tailored to prospects’ needs.
Engage with Microsoft sellers, technology specialists and industry teams to coordinate joint deal pursuits.
Monitor industry trends and competitor activity to inform strategy.
Maintain pipeline data in VeriPark’s CRM and provide regular sales forecasts and opportunity updates to leadership.
Participate in marketing activities, industry events and tradeshows, handling conversations and delivering presentations during sponsored events.
